description: AGSC-11-18 from 1.1, the webmcp half for the three tools that 1.1 adds (AGSC-09-13). `readOnlyHint: true` on `brief`, `explain` and `check`, which write nothing; `untrustedContentHint: true` on `brief`, whose result carries prose (the titles and the quoted prose of the selection), and `untrustedContentHint: false` on `explain` and `check`, whose results are slugs, keys, rule names and codes only, as `links` is. The seven tools of 1.0 stay as bnd-0036 states them. The `mcp` half is repeated from bnd-0036 so that the case runs through the same handler: the settings object of the extension identifier `com.agenticsystemcore/knowledge` under the capabilities the node reports, one member `linkset`, the absolute https URL of this node's /.well-known/knowledge-linkset for the stated `site.base`.
